name: bun
purpose: Test runner and coverage collector via `bun test --coverage`

name: biome
purpose: Primary linter and formatter (lint errors + warnings) via `biome check --reporter=json`

name: oxlint
purpose: Fallback linter when biome is absent, via `oxlint --format=json`

name: jscpd
purpose: Copy-paste / duplication detection across TypeScript and JavaScript files
